title: Caffeine Is Not 200mg For Everyone. It Is 3-6mg Per Kilo.
description: The performance research doses caffeine by bodyweight, so a 60 kg lifter and a 90 kg lifter are not looking at the same number. Above roughly 9 mg/kg there is no further benefit and the side effects climb. Our free checker converts it for your weight. #Caffeine #PreWorkout #SportsNutrition #FuelnFitHub
